CEventWindowData.note: The type appears in reflection/template metadata, but this non-polymorphic inline object has no confirmed native RTTI descriptor.

locator_chain.chain: CIngameInterfaceIdlerGfx* +0x28 -> event-window manager; manager +0x10 data/+0x1C int32 count -> CEventWindow* entries of stride 8; CEventWindow +0xE8 -> inline CEventWindowData
locator_chain.native_accessor_proof: Exact .pdata slice 0xAA43C0..0xAA440A loads module+0x570F7B8, rejects null owner, loads owner+0x10, invokes MSVC dynamic_cast from CIdlerGfxBase to CIngameInterfaceIdlerGfx (destination TypeDescriptor module+0x501EF50, PMD mdisp 0), rejects null, then reads idler+0x88. The passive reader mirrors the already-proven cast with the exact primary-vtable gate module+0x40B1D30.
locator_chain.constructor_corroboration: 0xAA3EEA..0xAA3EF1 writes module+0x40B1D30 to the constructed in-game idler; 0xAA3F0D initializes idler+0x28 before the manager allocation/store later in the same exact constructor.
locator_chain.cross_contract: prewar_scope_v1_abi.json ownership_and_root and docs/ck3-native-ai/prewar-encounter-inputs.md stable passive root
locator_chain.capture_not_required: The previously proposed 0xAA72B0/0xAA8233 capture and 0xAA4070 cleanup remain useful live diagnostics only; production v1 uses the native accessor root and retains no engine pointer.
locator_chain.frontend_collision: Excluded structurally: the root is the native in-game accessor's CIdlerGfxBase dynamic-cast path and the passive mirror requires the CIngameInterfaceIdlerGfx primary vtable before reading +0x28. The frontend generic manager call at 0xE30E78 is never used as a root. Query admission additionally requires one CEventWindow primary-vtable match whose complete data+0x00 event instance ID equals the current ActiveEvent+0x1BC ID.

lifetime.construction: The manager tick allocates CEventWindow and passes ActiveEvent* at RVA 0xBAB9F5; the CEventWindow constructor invokes the CEventWindowData constructor on this+0xE8.
lifetime.destruction: The CEventWindow destructor invokes the CEventWindowData destructor on this+0xE8.
lifetime.ownership_rule: CEventWindowData is valid only while its owning CEventWindow remains in the manager vector and alive on the UI/application thread.
lifetime.query_rule: Copy values during one owning-thread snapshot; never retain window, data, string or vector pointers after the call.

event_window_manager.capacity_boundary: No manager +0x18 capacity field is consumed by production v1 because this contract freezes only +0x10 data and +0x1C count. The signed count is bounded to 0..32; count>0 requires nonnull data.
event_window_manager.entry_admission: Every stored entry in the bounded manager vector must be nonnull and have the exact CEventWindow primary vtable module+0x417F758. A null or other dynamic type is treated as layout-invalid rather than skipped; manager keep-alive/remove/compact is the static evidence that live stored rows are CEventWindow ownership entries.

event_identity.current_active_event: Existing EventManager current-event getter RVA 0x2706AD0 resolves the live ActiveEvent; matching by the full +0x1BC instance ID is required.
event_identity.EventData_source: SPlayerEventData/ActiveEvent+0x1B0 -> EventData* on the current event path
event_identity.EventData_calculated_event_id: +0x08 int32; duplicate validator compares this field across the currently loaded EventData* rows; live Attempt3 proves it is process/playset-local and not a cross-process identity
event_identity.EventData_runtime_stats_ordinal: +0x0C int32; process/playset-local runtime statistics ordinal, not the stable definition identity
event_identity.stable_event_definition_key: EventData+0x10 canonical namespaced MSVC string; duplicate validator passes it as the first formatter argument for duplicate +0x08 calculated IDs
event_identity.EventData_authored_option_vector: +0x1B0 data, +0x1B8 capacity, +0x1BC int32 count; entries are CEventOption* in authored zero-based order
event_identity.EventData_source_location: +0x240 object; duplicate validator resolves the new and previous source-location strings for the second and third formatter arguments
event_identity.identity_query_rule: Copy +0x08/+0x0C/+0x10 only after the complete ActiveEvent instance ID is matched; validate MSVC string bounds and repeat the ActiveEvent/EventData pointer plus numeric/string observation before returning. +0x08/+0x0C must remain stable only within that loaded-process observation; only +0x10 is the cross-process definition identity. Never publish the EventData pointer.
event_identity.root_scope_stable_identity: ActiveEvent+0x00 root generic-event-target layout, stable type key and kind-4 generation-validated CharacterID payload identity are published by the production wire and static-tested, but the current-event root has not been read in a paused live artifact; non-character payload identity remains explicitly unavailable
event_identity.saved_scope_stable_identities: Production wire statically publishes the complete bounded named-row inventory as canonical script name, process-local name_identifier, stable target type key/subtype and CharacterID only for type 4; it has not been read in a paused live artifact and name_identifier is never a cross-process identity
event_identity.GetScope: GUI callback RVA 0x16D0990 resolves data+0x00 through EventManager and returns the live ActiveEvent pointer; it does not publish a stable cross-process scope identity.

ActiveEventScope.domain: generic nonreligious event-target context; no faith, doctrine, tenet, fervor, conversion, reformation, holy-war or holy-order semantics were inspected
ActiveEventScope.embedding: ActiveEvent+0x00 is an inline 0x168-byte EventTargetScope zero-offset base. ActiveEvent default construction calls RVA 0x81F190 with the original rcx; its copy/relocation path calls RVA 0x3358EF0 with the original destination/source; ActiveEvent serialization passes the unadjusted ActiveEvent pointer as r8 to RVA 0x20D8330. EventTargetScope construction initializes through +0x166 and ActiveEvent-specific construction resumes at +0x168.

root_generic_target.layout: ActiveEvent/EventTargetScope+0x00 is a 0x10-byte generic event-target token
root_generic_target.type_index: +0x00 uint16 generic type-registry index; zero is absent
root_generic_target.payload: +0x08 type-specific 8-byte payload; never publish it as a pointer or universal component ID
root_generic_target.serializer_proof: EventTargetScope serializer 0x20D83AE..0x20D83C0 passes the unadjusted scope pointer through RVA 0x81D880; that serializer dereferences the pointer and reads the uint16 at +0x00

named_target_vector.header: EventTargetScope+0x18 data pointer, +0x20 int32 capacity, +0x24 signed int32 count, +0x28 allocator pointer
named_target_vector.serializer_gate: 0x20D8407 compares dword [scope+0x24] with zero; 0x20D840D passes scope+0x18 to RVA 0x2539DA0
named_target_vector.row_name_identifier: +0x00 full signed int32 generation-bearing script-identifier ID; preserve the complete value including negative IDs; +0x04 remains opaque and is not published
named_target_vector.row_loop_proof: RVA 0x253BD00 loads vector data at header+0x00 and signed count at header+0x0C, computes end=data+count*0x18, resolves row+0x00 through 0x3B971A0/0x3B97090, passes row+0x08 to generic serializer 0x81D880 and advances by 0x18. RVA 0x335A370 independently copies rows in 0x18-byte units.

named_key_identity.id_to_entry_layout: mask identifier to low 24 bits, bound against table+0x3C signed count, return *(table+0x30)+index*0x20 where the row begins with an MSVC string
named_key_identity.read_rule: Resolve the complete signed int32 generation ID, including negative values, to a bounded nonempty key using the established lookup-only script-identifier table path and require an exact full-ID/string round-trip; never intern or accept the resolver fallback.

generic_type_identity.registry_layout: +0x00 data pointer, +0x0C signed int32 count, entry stride 0x50
generic_type_identity.proof: RVA 0x2011438 reads the token's uint16 type index, applies the same registry count/0x50-stride lookup, reads entry+0x00 and calls 0x3B58970
generic_type_identity.registry_fallback_entry_role: RVA 0x2011400 consumer selects this 0x50-byte registry fallback entry only when type_index is outside the signed registry count; the production reader must reject type_index >= count before computing an entry address and therefore never enter it
generic_type_identity.resolver_fallback_rejection: Reject native_name == bindings.generic_value_type_name_fallback before copying or publishing the type key
generic_type_identity.read_rule: Require nonzero type index, the exact module+0x4FFE290 registry, positive bounded signed count and type_index < count before computing index*0x50. This bounds gate prevents entry into the consumer's module+0x5000AB0 registry fallback row. Resolve the in-range entry identifier through 0x3B58970, require kGenericValueTypeNameFallbackRva = 0x585F058 and Bindings::generic_value_type_name_fallback = module+0x585F058, then reject that returned native_name. The 0x5000AB0 registry row and 0x585F058 resolver string are distinct fallbacks and must never be aliased. A stable type key does not make its payload identity known.

character_payload_identity.exact_resolvers: generic dispatcher RVA 0x33299E0 and character resolver RVA 0x201AD30
character_payload_identity.read_rule: Generation-resolve through Character storage and require CCharacter+0x18 to repeat the complete ID. Do not require the character resolver's later gameplay-liveness tail when only stable identity is requested.
character_payload_identity.boundary: This proves how to decode a type-4 token if one is observed; no paused current-event artifact has yet shown a root or named type-4 token.

saved_character_stale_identity_policy.evidence: Phase2 product R31/R33 repeatedly held active event instance 14 at date_raw 53147256 while one named Character token no longer generation-resolved; CK3 error.log independently reported a dead scope character during intrigue_dread.1501:after.
saved_character_stale_identity_policy.root_rule: Root Character identity remains strict: it must generation-resolve and round-trip the complete positive CharacterID or the whole frame is unavailable.
saved_character_stale_identity_policy.saved_scope_rule: For a named type-4 Character token only, preserve the canonical scope name, raw_type_index=4, subtype and type_key=character when the token no longer generation-resolves; publish typed_identity={status:unavailable,reason:character_scope_identity_unavailable} without a character_id. Other structural/name/type failures still invalidate the whole frame.
saved_character_stale_identity_policy.boundary: This does not claim the stale character is alive, does not fabricate or reuse an ID, and does not weaken root identity. It keeps the still-visible event definition and materialized options observable so an exact source contract may bind the scope name/type and choose fail-closed.

ActiveEventScope.noncharacter_payload_identity: Production wire publishes raw_type_index, subtype and stable type_key, then typed_identity={status:unavailable,reason:generic_scope_payload_identity_not_closed}; it never reads or publishes the +0x08 payload until that exact type receives its own decoder
